title: 'For the first time in decades, I have profound HOPE that everything I've sacrificed might not have been for nothing'
summary: Springer founded SHiFT and has spent decades funding it out of her own savings. She reads the book as evidence that the sacrifice need not end with a company losing the mission it was built for.
blockquote: Then along comes Eric Ries with Incorruptible, offering something I never imagined possible: a roadmap for building enormously successful companies without selling their souls. For the first time in decades, I have profound HOPE that everything I've sacrificed might not have been for nothing.
